approach: Native 32-bit source port of Nox using decompiled and reverse-engineered Windows game code, with portability and gameplay fixes.
help: 64-bit portability of code dependent on 32-bit memory layouts
Reverse engineering and documenting remaining game functions
Testing gameplay, networking and input across supported platforms
notes: Public native builds support complete single-player campaigns and multiplayer on Windows, Linux and ARM Linux handhelds, including PortMaster and Steam Deck. Requires separately obtained original Nox game data; no copyrighted game assets are distributed. The source remains 32-bit, with 64-bit support and continued reverse engineering as longer-term goals.
